facts.title: What has been demonstrated, and what has not

rows.label: Receipt pipeline, end to end, including tamper detection
rows.value: `make attest-demo` runs matrix → ledger → engine → raw JSONL → canonical receipt → signature → verification → manifest, then tampers with the receipt and requires exit code 3

rows.label: Statistical decision rules and their calibration
Batch-composition divergence
rows.value: 34 of 128 distinct logprob vectors at temperature 0; 5 of 128 remain under vLLM's batch-invariant mode, 1 of 128 under SGLang's deterministic mode [pending: needs a GPU or the CI kind cluster; recorded in bench/results, not re-observed by this offline harness]

rows.label: Cost of determinism
rows.value: 18.0% of throughput on SGLang, isolated from prefix caching (D/B ratio 0.820); 22.7% on vLLM, confounded with cache loss, 95% CI [0.741, 0.808] [pending: needs a GPU or the CI kind cluster; recorded in bench/results, not re-observed by this offline harness]

rows.label: Two-tenant cluster topology, both profiles
rows.value: GitHub Actions CI brings up the simulator-backed llm-d deployment in `default` and `hardened` and runs S-02 and FR-B-03 against it, for £0 [pending: needs Docker + kind; runs in the BARRIER CI workflow]

rows.label: The routing index leaks across tenants, and the tenant salt closes it
rows.value: ADR-012, CI run #15, 40 trials per profile, n=80 per verdict: `default` probe match ratio 1.0000 vs control 0.0000, AUC 1.0000 [1.0000, 1.0000], p=9.999e-05; `hardened` probe 0.0000, AUC 0.5000, at chance [pending: needs a GPU or the CI kind cluster; recorded in bench/results, not re-observed by this offline harness]

rows.label: A client-observable routing oracle on the simulator
rows.value: ADR-011, CI run #12, n=402: latency AUC 0.5581 [0.5026, 0.6138], p=0.0425, clearing no pre-registered threshold [pending: needs a GPU or the CI kind cluster; recorded in bench/results, not re-observed by this offline harness]

rows.label: A client-observable timing oracle on real vLLM
rows.value: FR-B-09. The simulator does not vary time-to-first-token on cache hits, so it cannot answer the question [pending: FR-B-09 is open: needs real vLLM on a GPU]

rows.label: Recovery of unknown victim content
rows.value: The measured attack is a confirmation oracle: the probe sends the victim's prompt verbatim, so the perfect match is by construction. It shows a guessed prefix being confirmed, nothing more [blocked: not claimed by design]
